description: This file contains unit tests for broadcast channel functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system, including scenarios with multiple subscribers, different delivery modes, and error handling.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelTests
classes.description: A test class validating the broadcast channel functionality with multiple test cases, setup fixtures, and nested configuration classes.

methods.name: ClientPublishSingleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests publishing multiple messages to a single broadcast channel and verifying received values.

methods.name: ClientPublishSingleChannelMultipleConsumersTest
methods.description: Tests publishing to a channel with multiple subscribers.

methods.name: ClientPublishMultipleChannelTest
methods.description: Verifies publishing different messages across multiple channels.

methods.name: MultipleSubscribersOneBadActorChannelTest
methods.description: Tests handling a subscriber that throws exceptions during message delivery.

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetClientPublishSingleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests publishing messages in non-fire-and-forget mode on a single channel.

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetClientPublishMultipleChannelTest
methods.description: Tests publishing messages across multiple channels in non-fire-and-forget mode.

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetClientPublishSingleChannelMultipleConsumersTest

methods.name: NonFireAndForgetMultipleSubscribersOneBadActorChannelTest

methods.description: Implementation testing multiple subscribers receiving published messages.

methods.name: MultipleSubscribersOneBadActorChannelTestImpl
methods.description: Implementation testing subscribers where one may throw exceptions.
